scope: One production assembly: Autofac. Includes 236 C# files under src/Autofac. No source is linked from another project.

Excludes test projects, benchmark projects, build scripts, all non-C# inputs, and 49 generated resource Designer.cs files. Each generated file has the leading single-line auto-generated marker already recognized by the counter. No extra generated-code rules are needed.

Features/GeneratedFactories is handwritten runtime factory-generation code, not generated source. It remains included. Util/NullableAttributes.cs is a handwritten compatibility shim, remains included unchanged, and is inactive without NETSTANDARD2_0. No separately vendored production library was identified in the selected directory.
conditional_compilation: Historical targets are netstandard2.1 and netstandard2.0. No project or target constants enter this measurement. NullableAttributes.cs and CircularDependencyDetectorMiddleware.cs contain target-conditional source.
The audit finds 95 nonblank lines of disabled preprocessor text across two files. These include comments and are not SLOC. The no-defines parse is not an actual historical target.

The project references System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource 4.7.1 and Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces 1.1.0. The measurement supplies modern runtime metadata instead, without these historical package assemblies. Analyzer packages do not enter the measurement either.
comparability: All 124 compiler errors are CS0103 missing generated resource-class names. There are 49 distinct missing names, each matched to an excluded Designer.cs file. No duplicate-definition diagnostics or parser errors appear.

These missing names occur in resource-message expressions rather than production type declarations. Available field and member symbols support a useful source-only comparison, but error recovery can affect operation binding. The ratios are not semantic ground truth.

RegistrationBuilder<TLimit,TActivatorData,TRegistrationStyle> supplies 528 of 1,105 possible method pairs (47.7828%) and no shared pairs. Its common state is reached through properties, which direct TCC deliberately does not follow. The pooled result is sensitive to this API shape.

representative_types.name: Autofac.Builder.RegistrationBuilder<TLimit, TActivatorData, TRegistrationStyle>
representative_types.interpretation: All 33 eligible methods have no direct instance-field accesses. Many configure the same RegistrationData object through an auto-property. The synthesized backing fields establish instance state but property accesses do not establish shared pairs. Direct TCC zero does not establish unrelated responsibilities.

representative_types.name: Autofac.Core.Registration.ComponentRegistry
representative_types.interpretation: All seven eligible methods share _registeredServicesTracker. Maximum direct TCC comes largely from forwarding to this one owner. Depth 12/13 below one coexists with maximum TCC, so TCC and depth cannot substitute for one another.

representative_types.name: Autofac.Core.Resolving.Pipeline.ResolvePipelineBuilder
representative_types.interpretation: Five eligible methods produce ten possible pairs and four shared pairs. WMC 40 behind eight API entries includes linked-list insertion, ordering checks, and pipeline construction. Private helper calls hide some shared-state work from direct TCC. Branching also raises depth.

representative_types.name: Autofac.Diagnostics.OperationSuccessDiagnosticData
representative_types.interpretation: One constructor and two properties produce WMC 1 and three API entries. Low depth is appropriate for a payload that carries a completed operation and its resolved instance. There are no eligible method pairs.

representative_types.name: Autofac.Features.Metadata.MetadataViewProvider
representative_types.interpretation: WMC 13 behind one API entry is the project maximum applicable depth. It hides constructor selection and expression-tree construction, plus private metadata lookup. TCC is not applicable because the utility has no instance state.
